_README: Reference thresholds. 'critical_*' are the ONLY values that can trigger 'critical'; they are absolute limits and are never adjusted for spaceflight. 'reference_*' are Earth clinical reference values that trigger 'attention'; for indicators listed in space_adaptation.json they are shifted by the expected in-flight adaptation. Fill in a value ONLY with a verified source (organization + URL). null = no threshold. These are Earth clinical references: no universally accepted in-flight thresholds exist.

heart_rate.source: American Heart Association: tachycardia is a resting heart rate over 100 beats per minute. https://www.heart.org/svt

bp_systolic.source: American Heart Association: hypertension stage 2 is 140/90 mm Hg or higher; hypertensive crisis is higher than 180 and/or higher than 120. https://heart.org/bplevels

bp_diastolic.source: American Heart Association: hypertension stage 2 is 140/90 mm Hg or higher; hypertensive crisis is higher than 180 and/or higher than 120. https://heart.org/bplevels

glucose.source: American Diabetes Association classification of hypoglycemia: level 1 is below 70 mg/dL, level 2 is below 54 mg/dL (Agiostratidou et al., Diabetes Care 2017;40:1622-1630). https://ada.silverchair.com/view-large/3051584

temperature.source: Fever: measured temperature of 38 °C (100.4 °F) or higher (U.S. National Library of Medicine, MedlinePlus). https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003090.htm
temperature.critical_source: Core temperature above 40 °C can have life-threatening consequences (Stahn et al., Scientific Reports 7:16180, 2017). https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5701078/

sleep_hours.source: American Academy of Sleep Medicine and Sleep Research Society: adults should sleep 7 or more hours per night; six or fewer hours is inadequate to sustain health and safety. https://aasm.org/seven-or-more-hours-of-sleep-per-night-a-health-necessity-for-adults/

mood.source: No documented threshold: self-reported, non-clinical scale.

alertness.source: No documented threshold: self-reported, non-clinical scale.

pvt_lapses.source: No validated cut-off for the number of lapses; compared with the astronaut's own baseline only.

pvt_mean_rt.source: No validated cut-off; compared with the astronaut's own baseline only.
